name: Ousaka Hisashi
source:
The protagonist of this story. A few years ago, he started working part-time to pay for college.

He spent a lot of time with Yayoi, and as she looked after him so kindly, he developed feelings for her. 

After passing his entrance exams, he confessed his feelings to her. He is currently a college student.
